What Elite is

[Elite](/products/aion-2-cheats/elite/) is the private aion 2 cheats build at aion2cheats.net—limited slots, priority patch queue, and every module from Lite and Pro plus bots, Auto Kill, Auto Interrupt, full ESP wallhack, and Costume Changer.
Elite is not day-one software; it is for operators who already win on Pro and want the full toolkit without module gaps.
What Elite adds over Pro
Farm Assist, Auto Kill, Auto Interrupt, complete ESP wallhack suite with smoke and vision tuning, Costume Changer, stack timers, loadout manager, and direct dev support on Discord.
Patch delivery hits Elite first when anti-cheat or game updates land—critical for high Abyss rank operators who cannot afford downtime.
Who should upgrade
Upgrade after two or more weeks of clean Pro sessions with conservative aim smoothness. Stay on Pro if you are still learning Aimbot basics or play casually on weekends.
Elite power without discipline increases report volume in Abyss PvP. If you die to hostile players with Lite ESP on, fix ESP wallhack settings before buying bots.
Safe Elite tuning
Load Elite conservative presets from the portal—not max bots on day one. Test Auto Kill in instances before Abyss PvP. Enable Farm Assist only when you understand farm-route timing impact.
ESP wallhack: start at 1200 unit ESP max; expand after clean games. Details: [ESP wallhack setup](/blog/aion-2-esp-wallhack-setup/). Smoke alerts at medium sensitivity reduce false positives.
Costume Changer on Elite

Elite bundles [Costume Changer](/blog/aion-2-costume-changer-guide/) with automation—cosmetic preview plus Abyss aimbot in one dashboard. Standalone Unlock All exists if you only want visuals without bots.
Streamers pair Costume Changer with [stream-proof setup](/blog/aion-2-stream-proof-setup/)—test OBS capture separately from ESP hiding.
Elite external architecture

All tiers including Elite use external architecture—see [external cheat guide](/blog/aion-2-external-cheat-guide/). Cloud config sync and patch delivery run through the operator portal, not a separate game client.
Elite operators get priority cloud sync bundles on patch days before Lite and Pro public builds.
